toolbox_name: CI13XX オフライン音声認識

chipintelli_asr_init.message0: initialize CI13XX offline ASR timeout %1 ms
chipintelli_asr_init.tooltip: Start the shared SDK and wait for microphone and offline ASR tasks.

chipintelli_asr_end.tooltip: Clear the result queue and detach this listener; the shared SDK stays active.

chipintelli_asr_read_results.tooltip: Poll each queued result and execute child blocks in the current Arduino task.

chipintelli_asr_available.tooltip: Check whether the result queue is non-empty.

chipintelli_asr_result_command_id.tooltip: Return the command ID from the result currently being handled.

chipintelli_asr_result_score.tooltip: Return the recognition score; CWSL results report zero.

chipintelli_asr_result_frames.tooltip: Return the frame count; wake-word and CWSL results may report zero.

chipintelli_asr_result_text.tooltip: Return copied command text with a capacity of 64 bytes.

chipintelli_asr_result_text_truncated.message0: current ASR result text was truncated
chipintelli_asr_result_text_truncated.tooltip: Check whether command text exceeded the 64-byte result buffer.

chipintelli_asr_dropped_results.tooltip: Return the accumulated result-queue overflow count.

chipintelli_asr_aec_enabled.tooltip: Check the compile-time acoustic echo cancellation profile.

chipintelli_asr_barge_in_enabled.tooltip: Check whether wake words or commands may interrupt prompt playback.

chipintelli_asr_barge_in_mode.tooltip: Return 0 disabled, 1 wake word only, 2 command only, or 3 both.

chipintelli_asr_barge_in_mode_value.tooltip: A constant for comparison with the current voice-interruption mode.
